description: Manufacturing earnings call showing top-line revenue expansion alongside operating margin contraction from input cost inflation.
current_transcript: Operator: Welcome to the Apex Industrial Dynamics second quarter 2026 earnings conference call. During the second quarter, total revenue reached $500 million, reflecting steady volume demand across equipment segments. Operating margin for the quarter was 12 percent. Free cash flow generated during the quarter was $40 million. Raw material inflation and transportation freight surcharges created margin headwinds throughout the period. We continue to execute cost containment initiatives.

historical_transcripts.label: Q2 2025
historical_transcripts.transcript: Operator: Welcome to the Apex Industrial Dynamics Q2 2025 earnings call. For the second quarter of 2025, total revenue was $450 million. Operating margin for the prior year quarter was 16 percent. Free cash flow for the period was $55 million. Manufacturing throughput remained stable.
